model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates inference time as a function of batch size for three 1B-parameter models, showing bars for Llama-1B, Lamba-1B, and MambaInLlama-1B. The x-axis is labeled “Batch size” on a linear scale with discrete tick labels at 1, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 300. The y-axis is labeled “Inference time (seconds)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10 with major ticks every 2 seconds. The Llama-1B series is shown in blue bars and increases with batch size from just above 3 seconds at batch size 1 to a little above 10 seconds at batch size 300, with intermediate heights around ~3–4 seconds for batch sizes 16–64, ~5.5 seconds at 128, and ~9 seconds at 256. The Lamba-1B series is shown in orange bars, starting near ~1 second at batch size 1 and rising to about ~3 seconds at batch size 300, with intermediate values around ~1.2–1.5 seconds for batch sizes 16–64, ~2 seconds at 128, and ~2.5 seconds at 256. The MambaInLlama-1B series is shown in red bars, starting slightly below the orange bar near ~0.9–1 second at batch size 1 and increasing to roughly ~2.8–3 seconds at batch size 300, with values around ~1.1–1.4 seconds for batch sizes 16–64, ~1.8–2 seconds at 128, and ~2.4–2.6 seconds at 256; small black text annotations above the red bars indicate speedup values of approximately “×3.6,” “×3.3,” “×3.1,” “×2.8,” “×3.2,” “×3.7,” and “×3.7” across the batch sizes from 1 through 300.
